lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: The DPU of 2,700 for Aug-2026 and Feb-2027 is held only by drawing ~198m and ~184m yen from a reserve that falls to 256m yen (~253 yen/unit) after Feb-2027, against cruise DPU of 2,465/2,452, and the BOJ raised to 1.0% in June 2026 after the February forecast (which assumed 905m/925m yen of interest and fees); the first Aug-2027 guide published with this release can hold 2,700 only by exhausting the reserve, so a guide below 2,700 is the more likely surprise direction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025 print (Aug-2025 DPU 2,780 vs 2,700 guided plus new Feb-2026 guide) -1.04% next session; Apr 2026 print (new Feb-2027 guide at 2,700) -0.45%; Feb-2026 revision with offering -0.95% (Yahoo daily bars).

findings.finding: Hotel variable rents ran at records (ACCESS by LOISIR HOTEL Nagoya +14.0% to record sales, Quintessa Sapporo inbound-driven) and this REIT paid above its DPU guide the last time a summer period closed (Aug-2025: 2,780 vs 2,700), so Aug-2026 actual EPU/DPU is likely at or a little above the 2,504/2,700 forecast, with any excess more likely retained than paid.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Aug-2025 beat (+80 yen DPU) printed -1.04% next session: beats on this line have been sold or ignored.

findings.finding: The 2026-09-29 swap (buy Luxena Kamimaezu 1,867m yen, sell Rockfield Nishi-Oi 578m yen with a ~23m yen gain, ~23 yen/unit in Feb-2027) is stated by the company to have minor impact with no forecast revision.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-09-29 announcement: +0.26% next session.

outside_window.finding: Reserve exhaustion after Feb-2027 makes the cruise DPU (~2,450) the binding level from FP Feb-2028 unless gains on sale or the 3,500 mid-term target materialise.

findings.finding: This release carries the first 2027/8 (第51期) forecast, which includes Kobe Steel's exit from ON Building on 2027-03-31: the whole building, 4.1% of NLA, NOI about 1.24bn yen a year (3.1% on 39.9bn). The new tenant takes only 37% of the floor area from 2027-04-01, and the rest of its 68.3% phases in from 2027-10 to 2028-04. That leaves roughly 100-170 yen a unit of mechanical DPU drag against 1,795, unless the REIT draws on 4,216m yen (1,184 yen a unit) of internal reserve. It has done exactly that before: Kioicho in 2015 and Shiodome in 2021.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This line is introduced at the October prints, when a new August-period forecast first appears. Those prints moved -0.59% (2022-10-19), -1.49% (2023-10-19), -2.88% (2024-10-23, the first print after Kobe Steel announced its move) and -0.63% (2025-10-23), next close against release-day close (Yahoo daily bars). The April 2026 print, which carried new leasing news (the Sunroute contract) and a 13.4% rise in NAV, moved +3.68%.

findings.finding: The 2026/8 actual DPU will most likely land modestly above the 1,814 yen forecast. The REIT beat its latest forecast in each recent period (2025/8 1,854 against a 1,766 initial; 2026/2 1,837 against 1,791 revised). The hotel variable rents for this period are set on base months of Nov 2025 to May 2026, when Japan Hotel REIT reported H1 2026 RevPAR up 4.9%, against MTR's 100% YoY assumption. No 予想修正 was filed, so the result is within ±5%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025/8 beat the forecast by about 5% and the stock moved -0.63% on 2025-10-24. 2026/2 beat by about 2.6% and it moved +3.68%, but that print carried other news. A beat on its own has not reliably been paid.

findings.finding: The 2027/2 forecast of 1,795 yen faces mixed inputs. Its hotel base months are May to Nov 2026, and inbound arrivals fell 9.6% YoY in August 2026 on the China slump, against a company assumption of 101% hotel rent. The BOJ raised rates to 1.00% in June 2026, in line with the company's assumed 1.02% average funding cost. Office rent increases are running ahead of plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the last two prints the forecast for the next-but-one period moved by 5 yen or less (2026/8: 1,809 raised to 1,814). Small revisions have not been what moves this name.

findings.finding: The 9/30 notice says the REIT is still negotiating with several candidates for the remaining 31.7% of ON Building. A further signed lease could ride in the results package, as the Sunroute Plaza Shinjuku contract and the NAV jump did in April 2026, and the stock rose 3.68% that day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-22: new lease terms disclosed with the results and the stock moved +3.68% (the J-REIT ETF moved -0.17%).

outside_window.finding: Sunroute Plaza Shinjuku's new contract, with a higher fixed rent plus a variable rent, starts in September 2027, inside the 2028/2 period. That is beyond the two periods this release guides.

lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series): the ON Building drag and the negative October-print pattern are public, so p_up moved from 46 to 48 and the scaled number from -0.10 to -0.05. Finding sizes were left unchanged.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension. Findings were already balanced two positive and two negative, so nothing else changed.
